name: DRV8353S
description: TI DRV8353S 9-75V three-phase smart gate driver (SPI configuration variant) -- candidate gate driver for the power stage, all amperage tiers (TODO.md 5.1).
verification: VERIFIED -- full 40-pin map read directly from the local copy of [21] (TI SLVSDY6A, AUGUST 2018, REVISED JUNE 2019), Sec. 6 'Pin Configuration and Functions', 'DRV8353S RTA Package, 40-Pin WQFN With Exposed Thermal Pad, Top View' and the accompanying 'Pin Functions -- 40-Pin DRV8353 Devices' table (which lists both the DRV8353H hardware-config and DRV8353S SPI-config pinouts side by side; only the DRV8353S column is used here). Sec. 5 'Device Comparison Table' confirms DRV8353S = 3 integrated shunt amplifiers, no buck regulator, SPI interface -- correct target part for this repo. The DRV8353H-only pins (GAIN, IDRIVE, MODE, VDS -- resistor-set config pins replaced by SPI registers on the S variant) are correctly absent from this pin map; the previous UNVERIFIED placeholder's guess that a 6x-PWM INHx/INLx pin set would apply is confirmed correct in spirit, though the previous placeholder's total pin count (26, sequential 1-26) and every individual pin number were wrong -- this device is a 40-pin WQFN (RTA package), not a 26-pin part. UPDATED 2026-08-15: the exposed thermal pad IS now a symbol pin (41, 'PAD', passive) and is tied to GND. The earlier treatment -- pad modelled at footprint level only -- would have imported an isolated copper island under a part dissipating gate-drive power, because a pad with no matching symbol pin gets no net. The pad's net assignment is an engineering default, not a datasheet value; see this pin's 'func' field. Package (mechanical drawing, p.98, doc 4219112/A): RTA0040B, WQFN, 6.1x5.9mm body max / 5.9x... min (dual-tolerance box read as 6.1/5.9mm), 0.5mm pitch, ~4.15x4.15mm exposed thermal pad. FOOTPRINT RESOLVED 2026-08-15: no KiCad 9.0 standard footprint matches RTA0040B, so one was generated from TI's own EXAMPLE BOARD LAYOUT and EXAMPLE STENCIL DESIGN sheets (drawing 4219112/A) by symbols/tools/gen_drv8353s_rta0040b_footprint.py. Copper, mask and paste are manufacturer-recommended values, not an IPC derivation.

pins.name: PAD
pins.func: exposed thermal pad. [21] RTA0040B drawing note 3: 'The package thermal pad must be soldered to the printed circuit board for optimal thermal and mechanical performance.' Tied to GND in this build as an ENGINEERING DEFAULT (AGENTS.md Sec.4) -- [21] mandates soldering the pad and Sec. 11.1 requires a ground-plane connection at the GND pin, but does not state that the pad is internally common with GND.
